open_questions: КЦПН (Координационный Центр Помощи Новороссии, @kcpn2014; head Александр Любимов) is the event owner. Two registry entities carry its lineage: Благотворительный фонд «Координационный центр помощи Новороссии» (`bf-ktspn-barnaul`, ИНН 2224171246, ЕГРЮЛ extract of 07.09.2026: founded 28.01.2015, liquidated by court decision 07.03.2018, director Еремеев) and Ассоциация «Взаимопомощь» (`assotsiatsiya-vzaimopomoshch`, ИНН 4707039070, director Любимов Александр Сергеевич; its own 2024 Минюст report, s0445, names «Дронница» among the events it held). The 2022 and 2023 editions are stated as run by КЦПН with no legal entity named, and the fund was already liquidated in 2018, so which legal entity stood behind those editions is not documented. (An earlier note here said КЦПН had no registry entity; that was wrong.)

Dates of the first edition conflict: the organisers' 2025 text (s8841) says «в августе 2022»; their own contemporaneous posts give 1-5 September 2022 (s8911 announcement, s8912 closing post). The contemporaneous posts are the better evidence; the 2025 wording is left on file as stated.

Participant lists are recorded only where a post names a company as an announced exhibitor and a registry entity is tied by its exact legal name. The 2023 announcements also name ДронНЕТ (s8916), «Мобил-груп» (s8917), КБ «Аякс Технологии» (s8918), КБ «Стратим» (s8919) and VECTOR (s8914); same-name entities exist for the first four (`ooo-dronnet`, `ooo-mobil-grup`, `ooo-ayaks-tekhnologii`, `ao-stratim` / `ooo-stratim`) but no identifier or named person in the posts ties them, so no participation is recorded for them.
